description: Claude Code's plan, stone by stone: its task list as a live sheet, the files touched at each step (before/after), and "Claude is waiting for you".
config.accent: Color of the step in progress (hex).
config.staleHours: After this many hours without an update, a roadmap is greyed out as old.
config.notifications: VS Code notification when Claude is waiting for a permission or an answer.
config.planGate: Claude stops after making its plan, until you say go from the roadmap (with your changes and notes).
config.language: Language of the view (auto: VS Code's).
config.requireRoadmap: On a large request, Claude must make its roadmap before going further (it is stopped once, with the reason).
config.threshold: Actions Claude may take on a request before the roadmap is required.
config.gateWait: With the plan gate on, how long Claude waits for your go (seconds) before simply ending its turn; then any message, or /cairn:go, carries the go.
config.snapshots: Exact +/− per step: in a git repository, snapshots of the project at each step, kept in ~/.claude/cairn/objects for a week (your repository is never written to). Off: only Claude's own edits are counted.
config.historyDays: How long past roadmaps are kept (days).
config.history: Keep past roadmaps (History tab). Off: only the current roadmap is kept, and the tab is hidden.
config.trail: Show the trail: one stone per step on the way to the summit.
config.timeLeft: Show the rough time left to the summit (otherwise the percentage).
config.lines: Show the lines each step changed (+/−).
config.files: Show the files touched under each step.
config.steering: Show the buttons to leave a note, remove or add a step.
config.sessions: Show the pills to switch between several Claude sessions in the same folder.
config.sticker: Show the "Claude is waiting for you" sticker in the view.
config.statusBar: Show Cairn in the status bar.
